forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
In week 31 of July, teams completed 1 visit, with 4 survey and 4 clearance teams active. No zone surveys, technical surveys or clearances were completed. So far, 21 zones have been surveyed, 7 declared free, 21 areas released and 9 areas cleared.

Officer attention: the access feed shows 13 zones closed. No teams were stood down or had reports overdue by more than a week. No dossiers or reports were held or queried. Plan P07 remains in place; no new plan was approved.

The forecast, made in week 27 for the zones of the plan it was made with and counting work already done, gives a range of 11 to 15 mine areas cleared this season and 8 to 10 zones declared free.
